consent.ts:44-55: DNT, GPC and the toggle are checked before the e2e override. The override needs NODE_ENV !== "production", which Next inlines at build time, so a prod user cannot flip it from window. analyticsId uses crypto.randomUUID under a dedicated key and never reads rq_anon_id. sessionTracker JSON.parse sits in try/catch with a filter on DAY_FORMAT

httpAdapter.ts posts same-origin only (INGEST_PATH) with credentials:"omit", sets no cookies and loads no scripts. The queue is capped (QUEUE_CAP) and there is a session cap. Failure logs never include the payload. The survey path sends no id and only app_version. Opt-out drops the queue and clears the id (adapter.ts:33-36)

route.ts:59-75 runs in this order: env kill switch, isSameOrigin, bot UA (not stored), then a per-IP rate limit keyed on a truncated sha256 of x-real-ip (raw IP never logged or forwarded). After that: readBodyWithLimit with a 64KB cap, JSON parse returning 400, validateBatch, slice to BATCH_SIZE, sink. The response is always an empty 204/400 with no payload echo. Relay server files are unchanged.
